facts.text: SFA's Purple Promise covers 100% of tuition and mandatory fees for up to four years for qualifying incoming Texas freshmen and transfer students.

sources.title: Purple Promise | SFA
sources.quote: Incoming fall first-year and transfer students who qualify will have 100% of their tuition and mandatory fees covered for up to four years as long as they maintain their eligibility.
sources.closest: attend sfa without student loans or paying out of pocket! incoming fall first-year and transfer students who qualify will have 100% of their tuition and mandatory fees2 covered for up to four years1 as long as they maintain their eligibility.

facts.text: Stephen F. Austin State University requires all first-time, first-year students to live on campus.

sources.title: SFA responds to record demand with intentional enrollment strategy
sources.quote: The requirement to live on campus will apply only to first-time, first-year students.
